### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_spreadsheet` | Read an app-authorized spreadsheet and sheet metadata. Set includeGridData=false for a light response. | yes | no | auto |
| `create_spreadsheet` | Create a spreadsheet, for example body.properties.title="Budget". | no | no | ask |
| `get_values` | Read an A1 range, for example Sheet1\!A1:B2, from the app-authorized spreadsheet. | yes | no | auto |
| `batch_get_values` | Read multiple A1 ranges, for example ranges=\["Sheet1\!A1:B2"\]. | yes | no | ask |
| `update_values` | Replace an A1 range with a two-dimensional values array. Use valueInputOption=RAW for literal values. | no | yes | deny |
| `append_values` | Append rows after the table in an A1 range. Use valueInputOption=RAW and body.values, for example \[\["Travel",20\]\]. | no | no | ask |
| `clear_values` | Clear values in the A1 range while preserving formatting; for example Sheet1\!A1:B2. | no | yes | deny |
| `copy_sheet` | Copy one sheet to another app-authorized spreadsheet. Use numeric sheetId=0 and destinationSpreadsheetId. | no | no | ask |
